name: YITAMOTOR 48" Bucket Clamp-On Pallet Fork 2500 lbs Attachments
fitment:
Compatible with 48” or Bigger size Tractor Buckets.
Widely in farms, factories, and warehouses for highly efficient mechanical loading/unloading, stacking, and short-distance transportation, the pallet fork easily handles palletized loads.
Note: This Clamp on Debris Forks can withstand up to 2500 pounds. After testing, as long as it does not exceed the product's bearing range, the bucket will not bend. Before purchasing, please confirm whether the tractor bucket is suitable for installing this Clamp on Debris Forks.
For your safety, professional installation is recommended.

description:
YITAMOTOR Clamp-on Debris Forks are compatible with a 48” or Bigger size Tractor Bucket. Buckets less than 2 inches thick are perfect for this product.
Fitment
Compatible with 48” or Bigger size Tractor Buckets.
Widely in farms, factories, and warehouses for highly efficient mechanical loading/unloading, stacking, and short-distance transportation, the pallet fork easily handles palletized loads.
Note: This Clamp on Debris Forks can withstand up to 2500 pounds. After testing, as long as it does not exceed the product's bearing range, the bucket will not bend. Before purchasing, please confirm whether the tractor bucket is suitable for installing this Clamp on Debris Forks.
For your safety, professional installation is recommended.
Features
Heavy Duty
Material: Surface of the product is sprayed with plastic to effectively
place the product rust vcorrosion. This clamp on debris forks is made of
high-quality materials and has good load-bearing performance, which has
max load capacity up to 2500 lbs.
Easy Installation: Simply slide the debris forks over the edge of the
bucket and clamp it down to lock. With the capability to hauling logs,
lumber, and firewood and move fence posts, hay bales, clear debris and
so on.
Usage Scenarios: The 48" bucket debris forks are used widely in farms,
factories, and warehouses for good mechanical loading / unloading,
stacking, and short distance transportation, the pallet forks easily
handles palletized loads.
Item Specifications: The overall size of the tractor debris forks is
31" (L) x 42" (W). With a weight of approximately 70.99 lbs, and 5 fork
tines measure 21" (L) x 2" (W) x 2" (H), it fits 48" bucket or bigger
size bucket.
Fitment Reference: YITAMOTOR clamp on debris forks compatible with 48"
or bigger size tractor bucket. Buckets less than 2 inches thick are good
for this product.
